descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，查询当前阿里云账号下的目录列表。返回结果显示，当前阿里云账号下只有一个ID为`d-00fc2p61****`的目录。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to query the directories within your Alibaba Cloud account. The returned result shows that only one directory with the ID `d-00fc2p61****` is created within your Alibaba Cloud account.
